lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keteeaa tereeaa kudaratee kevad teree daat ||
lines.translation: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kete tere jee ja(n)t siphat karahi din raat ||
lines.translation: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||
lines.translation: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai sach oopajai sach mahi saach samaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat hovai pat oogavai gurabachanee bhau khaai ||
lines.translation: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape lae milaai ||4||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalee saree j ubaree haumai muee gharaahu ||
lines.translation: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: doot lage phir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu ||
lines.translation: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kalap tiaagee baad hai sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
lines.translation: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re sach milai bhau jaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bin nirabhau kiu theeai guramukh sabad samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ketaa aakhan aakheeai aakhan tot na hoi ||
lines.translation: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)gan vaale ketaRe daataa eko soi ||
lines.translation: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke jee paraan hai man vasiai sukh hoi ||2||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag supanaa baajee banee khin mahi khel khelaai ||
lines.translation: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jogee mil ekase vijogee uth jaai ||
lines.translation: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so theeai avar na karanaa jaai ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vasat vesaaheeai sach vakhar sach raas ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa gur poore saabaas ||
lines.translation: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudaa jis paas ||4||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaat milai phun dhaat kau siphatee siphat samaai ||
lines.translation: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||
lines.translation: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhaai ||1||
lines.translation: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa gur paaeeai mukat padaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochau thaan suhaavanaa oopar mahal muraar ||
lines.translation: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach karanee de paaeeai dar ghar mahal piaar ||
lines.translation: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh man samajhaaeeai aatam raam beechaar ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tribidh karam kamaaeeahi aas a(n)desaa hoi ||
lines.translation: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu gur bin trikutee chhutasee sahaj miliai sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeai nadar kare mal dhoi ||3||
lines.translation: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiu ghar vaas ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko sabad veechaareeai avar tiaagai aas ||
lines.translation: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dekh dikhaaeeai hau sad balihaarai jaas ||4||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig jeevan dohaaganee muthee doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar keree ka(n)dh jiu ahinis kir dhahi paai ||
lines.translation: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai sukh naa theeai pir bin dookh na jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dhe pir bin kiaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
